name: Suiryu
roles: Continuous Follow-up and High Internal Injury

skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 2 consecutive strikes to a single target for 120% ATK, with a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury]. [Internal Injury]: Deals 100% of Suiryu’s ATK when the affected target is attacked, then disappears after triggering.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies in a row with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 400% ATK DMG. Triggers [Breakthrough], removing 1 instance of [Unyielding] or [Specialized Unyielding]. [Breakthrough] can trigger up to once during each action. Has a 75% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the main target and 3 random enemies. [Internal Injury]: Deals 600% of Suiryu’s ATK when the affected target is attacked, then disappears after triggering. Grants self [Specialized Guard] equal to 400% ATK, up to 15 stacks.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies in a row with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 600% ATK DMG. Each hit can trigger [Breakthrough], removing 1 instance of [Unyielding] or [Specialized Unyielding], with no activation limit during the action. Has a 90% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the main target and 3 random enemies. [Internal Injury]: Deals 750% of Suiryu’s ATK when the affected target is attacked, then disappears after triggering. Grants self [Specialized Guard] equal to 600% ATK, up to 15 stacks.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains 50% [Injury Boost]. Grants self 50% [Non-Crit DMG Free] for 4 turns. When receiving fatal DMG, triggers [Unyielding] and restores 50% Max HP. Can trigger once per battle.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains 65% [Injury Boost]. Grants self and allies in the same column 50% [Non-Crit DMG Free] for 4 turns. When receiving fatal DMG, triggers [Unyielding] and restores 50% Max HP. Can trigger up to 2 times per battle.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains 80% [Injury Boost]. Grants self and allies in the same column 60% [Non-Crit DMG Free] for 4 turns. When receiving fatal DMG, triggers [Unyielding] and restores 80% Max HP. Can trigger up to 2 times per battle.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: After actively casting the Ultimate, performs [Continuous Follow-Up] 2 times against random enemy rows affected by [Internal Injury], dealing 100% of the Ultimate’s DMG with 100% of its effects. If fewer than 2 enemies remain, the remaining enemies can still be targeted repeatedly. Suiryu is permanently immune to [Adhesion] and [Paralyzed] while performing a Follow-Up.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: After actively casting the Ultimate, performs [Continuous Follow-Up] 3 times against random enemy rows affected by [Internal Injury], dealing 100% of the Ultimate’s DMG with 100% of its effects. If fewer than 3 enemies remain, the remaining enemies can still be targeted repeatedly. After recovering from [Unyielding] or [Specialized Unyielding], immediately performs [Continuous Follow-Up] 2 times against random enemy rows, dealing 80% of the Ultimate’s DMG with 100% of its effects. If fewer than 2 enemies remain, the remaining enemies can still be targeted repeatedly. Suiryu is permanently immune to [Adhesion] and [Paralyzed] while performing a Follow-Up.

effects.desc: Deals DMG based on Suiryu’s ATK when the affected target is attacked, then disappears after triggering.

Increases DMG dealt by [Injury] and [Internal Injury] effects.
Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].
Repeatedly performs the Ultimate as a Follow-Up with the specified DMG and effect percentages.

A control effect that Suiryu is immune to while performing a Follow-Up.
